# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary analysis documents generated during the application assessment. Each document covers a specific architectural dimension of the PhotoAlbum application.

## Supplementary Documents

| Document | Description |
|---|---|
| [Architecture Diagram](./architecture-diagram.md) | High-level application architecture (layer diagram) and detailed component relationship diagram for the ASP.NET Core 9.0 Razor Pages application |
| [Dependency Map](./dependency-map.md) | Visual map of all external NuGet package dependencies grouped by functional category, with version compatibility notes and test dependency inventory |
| [API & Service Communication Contracts](./api-service-contracts.md) | Complete inventory of Razor Pages handler endpoints, request/response types, DTO contracts, communication patterns, and security posture |
| [Data Architecture & Persistence Layer](./data-architecture.md) | Database configuration, EF Core entity model (ER diagram), repository access patterns, caching strategy, data ownership boundaries, and PII classification |
| [Configuration & Externalized Settings Inventory](./configuration-inventory.md) | All configuration sources, runtime profiles, properties inventory, secrets handling, startup dependency chain, feature flags, and framework version catalog |
| [Core Business Workflows](./business-workflows.md) | End-to-end business workflows (upload, browse, view, delete), domain entity mapping, business rules, validation logic, and primary workflow sequence diagram |
